free_parameters.why: head count is absent from the witness hint; the target assertion compares only the sequence lengths q.shape[1] and k.shape[1], so the head count cannot change the decision

free_parameters.why: required positional argument not in the witness hint; the target assertion is evaluated before gamma is used, so its value cannot change the target decision

free_parameters.why: CPU test tensors; the target assertion depends only on tensor shapes, not on the element dtype
